subject: Full Stack Development Internship – Aditya Mittal
body:
Hi Vidyalai team,

Your internship post asks for highly available REST API endpoints, which makes sense when every lesson is a live one-to-one session. That's the kind of backend work I've been doing.

I built MedVault: upload a lab report PDF, get a plain-language explanation you can ask questions about. Django REST backend with JWT refresh-token rotation and per-user data isolation: https://medvault-xor.vercel.app

I'm a 2027 CS grad looking for an internship. Is the Cochin team still taking applications for this role?

tailor.reason: Detailed MERN-leaning full stack JD sent to a careers inbox; the master resume lacks the JD's exact terms REST API, JavaScript frameworks and maintainable code.
